name: Ms. Detective - File #1: Iwami Ginzan Satsujin Jiken
original_name: ミス・ディテクティヴ　ファイル#1　石見銀山殺人事件
source:
Chisato Higari is a detective to receive a request to find client's missing father. You get to know that father is in Omori but when you get there there is a news report about his death and at the same time your client disappears. Is the corpse floating in the sea of Japan truly client's father? Where did the client disappear? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-september-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
日向千里是一名侦探，接到委托寻找客户失踪的父亲。她得知对方在大森，赶到那里后却看到父亲死亡的新闻，同时客户也失踪了。漂浮在日本海上的尸体真的是客户的父亲吗？客户又去了哪里？

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-september-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
